title: Argentina, 1976-1983: the junta, the economy and the Malvinas war
goal: I can tell how the military governed Argentina and why it left power, using se.

items: I can say when the coup happened and who led the junta.
I can say what was done with the Congress and the parties.
I can say what happened in the Malvinas war.
I can use *se* to say what was done without naming who did it.
I can say what was done using *se* without naming who did it.
I can say when the coup in Argentina happened and who led the junta first.
I can say what happened to the Congress and the political parties.
I can say what happened in the Malvinas war.
I can say when and how civilian rule came back.
